transcript:
MARTIN: I got the building plans here. Hold on...

[SFX: We hear a rustling of paper from Martin frantically looking for something.]

MARTIN: Ok. Calm down! Calm down! There should be a window on that floor, see if you can get out from there. If not, look for a fire escape on the second floor - find the stairs...

[SFX: running]

DAVID: The windows are all boarded up!

MARTIN: Damn! The stairs. Back near the foyer.

[SFX: running along hallway]

DAVID: (nervously) They're rickety as hell...

MARTIN: Is there any other way out that you can see?

DAVID: DAMN!! No... Okay... I'm going up...  

[SFX: David lets out an exhalation of panic, and turns and runs up the stairs. As he gets halfway up - the stairs crack and break apart.]

[SFX: He screams as he tumbles downward.]

MARTIN: DAVID!!!?

[SFX: We hear a thud of David's body hitting concrete. Hard. We hear what must be the sound of a few of his bones breaking.]

MARTIN (CONT’D): ANSWER ME!!!

No answer.

MARTIN (CONT’D): David? Please... Say something... Please...

The silence is palpable. 

[IDLE LOOP: SFX: We hear the wind howling above David. Far above. Where he is sounds closed in.]
